patch_description:
This version combines the deterministic stochastic search strength of the current ring-based implementation with the coordinate-wise linear-program refinement idea from the stronger prior optimization script.

The configuration is represented inside a fixed reference triangle of area 1/2. Because the normalized objective is affine invariant, this does not restrict solution quality while avoiding repeated convex-hull computations. The three reference vertices remain fixed, all other points are projected into the triangle, and the normalized minimum triangle area is exactly the minimum absolute determinant.

A short deterministic annealing phase discovers useful orientation/sign patterns, focusing most moves on points involved in the current bottleneck triangle. Each promising solution is then polished by alternating linear programs that maximize the minimum signed determinant while holding the complementary coordinate fixed. This gives substantially faster local improvement than pure annealing and retains a deterministic NumPy-only fallback if SciPy is unavailable.
